summary: Frontend smoke + regression for iteration_17 (5 requested changes). 22 of 26 checks PASS. Emergent badge removal, nav pruning (no Bewertungen/Galerie), Probelektion→Lektion on DE, SocialFeed section (6 IG + 3 TT tiles with edit overlays in CMS edit mode), coral gradient on WhySafeRide, warm sunset-band gradient on Pricing 'Beliebt' card all confirmed. Location page FAQ data lives in a separate collection from content.json and was silently missed – consider a centralised 'copy audit' script that greps DB + code for legacy strings after global rename.

rca of the issue: The iteration_17 content patch touched 11 keys in content.json (hero.cta_*, ablauf.outro_*, homepage_faqs[5], why_safe_ride.pillars[0/4], why_safe_ride.cta_*, plus new 'social' key) but did NOT touch (a) English string literals inside JSX components (WhatsAppFab, HomeFaq, BuchungPage meta), and (b) location.faqs which live in a separate mongo collection (db.locations). Both gaps produce visible 'Probelektion' / 'trial lesson' occurrences that violate the acceptance criteria. Reproduction: (1) toggle EN on /, open WhatsApp FAB → first item still 'I'd like to book a trial lesson.', scroll to FAQ heading area → 'first trial lesson'. (2) visit /fahrschule-einsiedeln → the FAQ section shows 'Wie melde ich mich für eine Probelektion an?'. Mitigation: E1 should (a) rename literals in the 3 JSX files, (b) rename 'Probelektion' → 'Lektion' in the location seed (likely /app/backend/seeds/locations.py or similar) and either re-run seeding or PATCH each of the 11 location docs via /api/locations/{slug}.
